about.subtitle: About Tatsumi Cooperative
about.greetingBody: Tatsumi Cooperative is a business cooperative established under the Small and Medium-sized Enterprise Cooperatives Act. Founded on mutual support among our member businesses, our purpose is to support their operations through joint purchasing and related activities. We move forward steadily, together with the businesses of our region.

tit.title: Technical Intern Training
tit.subtitle: A general overview of the program
tit.overviewTitle: What is the Technical Intern Training program?
tit.overviewBody: The Technical Intern Training program was established to transfer Japanese skills, techniques and knowledge to people from developing countries, contributing to the economic development of their home countries. Across categories 1, 2 and 3, the program allows a maximum stay of five years.
tit.industriesNote: * Eligible occupations and tasks are prescribed by law and reviewed periodically. Please refer to publications by the relevant authorities for the latest details.
tit.flowNote: * This illustrates the general flow prescribed by the program.
tit.faqTitle: Frequently asked questions about the program

faq.q1: How long is the period of stay?
faq.a1: Across categories 1, 2 and 3, the program allows a maximum of five years. Requirements are prescribed for each category.
faq.a2: Eligible occupations and tasks are prescribed by law and reviewed periodically. Please refer to publications by the relevant authorities for the latest details.
faq.a3: This varies by occupation and category. In some fields, such as nursing care, language requirements apply at entry.
faq.q4: What happens with the transition to Ikusei-Shuro?
faq.a4: Transitional measures accompanying the launch of the Ikusei-Shuro program are set out in the relevant legislation and published guidelines.

ssw.title: Ikusei-Shuro
ssw.subtitle: A general overview of the program
ssw.overviewBody: The Ikusei-Shuro program was created to succeed the Technical Intern Training program and is scheduled to take effect by 2027. It aims to balance workforce development with workforce continuity, with a training period leading to transition into the Specified Skilled Worker status.
ssw.diffTitle: Main differences from Technical Intern Training

rows: 3 years in principle (transition to SSW envisaged)
To be permitted under certain conditions

period.title: Period of stay
period.desc: A training period of three years in principle, with transition into the Specified Skilled Worker status envisaged.

transfer.title: Changing employer
transfer.desc: The program is being designed to permit transfers at the person's own initiative under certain conditions.

japanese.title: Language requirements
japanese.desc: The program is being designed to introduce staged Japanese-language requirements.

ssk.title: Specified Skilled Worker
ssk.subtitle: A general overview of the residence status
ssk.overviewBody: Specified Skilled Worker is a residence status created in 2019 to accept foreign nationals with a certain level of expertise and skill in fields facing serious labour shortages. Skill level and Japanese-language ability are confirmed through examinations prescribed for each field.

n1.title: Category 1
n1.desc: For work requiring skills that call for a substantial degree of knowledge or experience. The period of stay is capped at five years in total.

n2.title: Category 2
n2.desc: For work requiring proficient skills. There is no overall cap on renewals of the period of stay.

ssk.fieldsBody: Covered fields include nursing care, construction, agriculture and manufacturing, among others. Fields are added and revised as the system is amended.
ssk.fieldsNote: * Covered fields and their requirements are reviewed periodically. Please refer to publications by the relevant authorities for the latest details.
ssk.diffTitle: Differences from Technical Intern Training and Ikusei-Shuro

rows: Cat. 1: 5 years total / Cat. 2: no cap
